prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: V18 website 4:3 immersive drawing-room scene, 4K-ready master artwork
Primary request: Redraw Image 2 completely from the ground up as a much cuter, more polished premium hand-painted anime illustration. Preserve the scene and interaction exactly; improve the character appeal, anatomy, hair, fabric, materials, depth, and lighting rather than merely sharpening the old pixels.
Input images: Image 1 is the mandatory character identity anchor; Image 2 is the mandatory composition, pose, outfit, room-geometry, and prop reference.
Scene/backdrop: The same cozy strawberry-pink bedroom at blue hour, with the same wooden desk, black pen-display tablet and stand, paper sketch stack at lower left, pencil cup at far left, shelf with headphones and plant, framed wall art, window and tied curtains, pink cat plush, mint mug, small plant, desk lamp, drawers, and every object in the same place.
Subject: The same shy silver-white-haired, bright-blue-eyed girl from Image 1, with the same rounded youthful face, tiny mouth, soft natural blush, pink bow hair clips, very long hair, and pink cat-ear zip hoodie over a cream top. She sits at the desk, leans slightly toward the pen display, looks down with a quietly absorbed and adorable expression, holds one stylus naturally in her right hand, and rests her left hand naturally at the upper edge of the display.
Style/medium: Original fan-art interpretation in polished Japanese hand-painted anime illustration; soft clean linework, delicate watercolor-like color transitions, precise hair strands, believable hands, plush knit and cotton texture, refined wood grain, nuanced warm/cool light, cute without becoming infantile.
Composition/framing: Exact 4:3 landscape composition and eye-level camera from Image 2; keep character scale, desk horizon, tablet angle, negative space, foreground papers, background geometry, and crop unchanged. Keep all important hands and props comfortably inside the frame.
Lighting/mood: Warm amber desk-lamp and fairy-light glow balanced with cool deep-blue evening window light; intimate, calm, soft, healing, and quietly focused.
Color palette: Strawberry milk pink, silver blue, mint, cocoa brown, cream paper, and restrained deep night blue.
Materials/textures: Fine silver hair, ribbed hoodie cuffs, soft fleece hood ears, matte black pen display, natural wood, creamy textured paper, ceramic mug, plush toy fur, and translucent curtain fabric.
Constraints: Preserve the same character identity, face proportions, hairstyle, hair accessories, outfit, pose, hand gesture, camera, composition, room geometry, prop count, prop placement, and interaction meaning. Exactly one girl, two arms, two hands, five fingers per visible hand, one stylus, one pen display. No in-image text.
Avoid: Mature or glamorous face, influencer makeup, sexualization, cleavage, stiff direct stare, blank expression, oversized baby head, excessive sparkle or bloom, neon, photorealism, 3D render, extra furniture, missing props, duplicate objects, extra limbs or fingers, malformed hands, warped tablet perspective, text, logo, signature, or watermark.
